explication: This repository packages Obsidian-focused Agent Skills for compatible coding agents. The principal workflow is: a user gives an agent a vault or content task, the agent loads the relevant skill instructions, and the skill produces or modifies an Obsidian artifact. The documented branches cover Markdown, Bases, Canvas, CLI-based vault work, web-to-Markdown extraction, and data-driven Markdown rendering. No implementation excerpts were provided, so relationships are limited to README-documented capabilities.
